title: Login page hangs on slow 3G connections
description: The login form never resolves when latency exceeds 2s; spinner runs forever.

title: Password reset email never arrives
description: Reset link email is not sent for SSO-linked accounts.

title: Checkout discount code SAVE10 computes wrong total
description: 10% discount applied as 5%; total shows 95.00 instead of 90.00.

title: Session timeout does not redirect to login
description: After token expiry the app shows a blank screen instead of redirecting.

title: Search returns stale results after reindex
description: Product search cache is not invalidated when the index rebuilds.

title: Checkout button double-submits order
description: Rapid double-click creates two orders; button lacks debounce.

title: Login with expired token returns 500
description: Expired bearer token triggers unhandled exception instead of 401.

title: CSV export times out on large datasets
description: Export of >50k rows exceeds the 30s gateway timeout.
